question: Highlight the distinguishing characteristics of cancer cells from normal cells. Describe the classifications of cancer. Add notes on carcinogens and how they cause cancer.

What causes double strand breaks in DNA? Elaborate on the mechanisms of double strand break repair in prokaryotes.

Explain with suitable diagram the structure of nephrons. Discuss the process involved in urine formation.
What are neurotransmitters? Briefly explain the types and functions of neurotransmitters. Elaborate the mechanism of nerve impulse conduction through a synapse.
